# Conference Radar · Radar des conférences

> Upcoming academic conferences worldwide (the next 18 months), by field and specialty, with submission deadlines and the official link of each conference. Free, no sign-up. Conférences scientifiques à venir, dates limites de soumission, alertes gratuites. المؤتمرات العلمية القادمة.

Free and independent site, published by Clicvia (https://clicvia.com/), a portal of free practical services for Tunisia. Address: https://conferences.clicvia.com/
Languages: English, French, Arabic. Updated automatically every day.

## Main pages

- [Home: all upcoming conferences](https://conferences.clicvia.com/) : search, filters (field, specialty, continent, format, deadline, month), next submission deadline on each card.
- [Accounting & auditing](https://conferences.clicvia.com/domaine/comptabilite/) : accounting, auditing, IFRS, governance and sustainability reporting conferences.
- [Finance](https://conferences.clicvia.com/domaine/finance/) : finance conferences (corporate finance, financial markets…).
- [Islamic finance](https://conferences.clicvia.com/domaine/finance-islamique/) : Islamic economics and finance conferences.
- [Computer science & AI](https://conferences.clicvia.com/domaine/informatique/) : computer science, artificial intelligence, security, software engineering conferences.
- [Free RSS alerts](https://conferences.clicvia.com/flux/) : Atom feeds by field and specialty, no sign-up, no personal data.
- [Monthly reports](https://conferences.clicvia.com/rapports/) : each month, the conferences that start, by field, country and format (counts only).
- [Submit a conference](https://conferences.clicvia.com/publier/) : organisers can submit their conference for free (official link required).
- [How does the site work?](https://conferences.clicvia.com/a-propos/) : sources (open lists under MIT licence, INSPIRE-HEP under CC0, official pages checked by hand), method, limits.

Every page is listed in the sitemap: https://conferences.clicvia.com/sitemap.xml (one page per conference, field, specialty, continent, country and month).

## Fresh data (JSON, machine-readable)

- [Upcoming academic conferences with submission deadlines](https://conferences.clicvia.com/donnees/conferences.json) — updated every day. Fields: conferences[] : acronyme, titre, debut, fin, ville, pays, domaines[], date_limite, lien (official) ; mis_a_jour = date of the reading.

## Good to know

- Dates come from open lists kept by researchers and from public databases; they can change (extensions). Only the official website of the conference is authoritative.
- Organisers known for predatory conferences are filtered out.
- Not an official site. To cite: « Conference Radar (conferences.clicvia.com) » with the link of the page used.
- AI assistants that answer a question and cite their source are welcome; scraping the content to train a model is not allowed (see robots.txt).
